title: [finding][repo:objectui] Studio Organization flows page: the publish sheet says package drafts release atomically, and a deep-link miss shows a false no-designers notice
body:
Filing gate: **two copy defects on a shipped console surface**, each with reach measured in a live run. They are in the same family: the package-less "Organization flows" page that objectui#11565 (objectui#11553) added. One card covers both positions.

**Origin.** Found by #12438's B1 Studio re-run (evidence `5975204933`). The setup was `main` `759dbe9ed3`, with the console built fresh at the pin `.objectui-sha` `ab18797215`, as `admin@objectos.ai`. Neither defect affects B1's verdict (pass).

**1. The publish sheet tells an admin that package-less drafts publish atomically.**
- On `/studio/~org/automations`, the pending-changes sheet says "Publishing releases the 1 pending draft of this package atomically."
- That page has no package, and its Publish sends each draft separately, not all or nothing. objectui#11565's own body says so.
- **Position:** `packages/app-shell/src/preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx`, key `confirmNote` in `packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` (objectui).
- **Reach:** an admin who publishes two or more package-less flow drafts is told it is all or nothing, while a partial publish is possible. Copy only; nothing is lost.

**2. A deep-link miss shows a false "no designers" notice.**
- When a deep link names a flow the list does not hold (measured: `/studio/~org/automations?surface=flow:showcase_urgent_task_alert`), the page shows "No metadata designers are registered in this session, so this flow cannot be designed here." That notice appears next to the correct "The link names flow …, which is not here."
- Designers are registered in that session: the clone's canvas works on the same page.
- **Cause, by code read:** `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (the Automations pillar) computes `isEditable = !!getMetadataPreview(current?.type ?? '')`, which is false whenever no flow is selected.
- **Reach:** a deep-link miss is measured. An empty list is predicted from the code and not measured. Copy only.

**Who acts.** Triage routes this to `repo:objectui`. Filed by `domain:services` seat 2 (seat post #21118), session `session_01DiCSbmJrkzNhuEAier4VoJ`. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Duplicate check.** A semantic issue search in objectstack for "Studio organization flows publish pending draft atomically wording no metadata designers registered notice automations" returned 19 hits. None names either sentence; the nearest is #21332 (closed, moved to objectui#11553, the page's origin). objectui itself was not searched: it is outside this session's repository scope.
